crossRefs.note: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.
“I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
“ ‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not…
“ ‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.
He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
translations.bsb: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
translations.kjv: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
translations.asv: I am Jehovah thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
